searchText: As previously announced,** the Ropsten network is shutting down **🌙 Several infra providers & validators have already stopped supporting the network, and we expect the remaining ones to turn off their nodes in the coming weeks. Full announcement here: https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/11/30/ropsten-shutdown-announcement

excerpts.content:
As previously announced,** the Ropsten network is shutting down **🌙  Several infra providers & validators have already stopped supporting the network, and we expect the remaining ones to turn off their nodes in the coming weeks.  

Full announcement here: https://blog.ethereum.org/2022/11/30/ropsten-shutdown-announcement
